rows.en: We're counting on you, Claire-senpai.
rows.notes: Onegai shimasu: the player handing the orders over to Claire. Male version (c22020 female).

rows.en:
Wowww, it looks great on you! You're gorgeous!
So sexy, Claire-senpai!!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Said after Claire has left to take orders.

rows.en:
...Akimizu, I think you should say that
kind of thing while Claire-senpai is
actually here.

No way... Talk to Claire-senpai while she's
in a china dress? I could never do that!
Well, I'll get back to work too.
Sigh... Claire-senpai is so wonderful......

(Akimizu really does adore
Claire-senpai, huh.)

(Huh? Come to think of it,
where did Klan-senpai go?)

(I see...
She went to show Michel her china dress.)

Well, Michel? How do I look in this china dress?
It suits me exceptionally well, does it not?
Hmm, let's see...

It suits me so well words fail you, does it not?
Heh heh. No need to say it aloud.
Your eyes tell me everything...

...You're wearing a china dress and still have
zero sex appeal. That's quite an achievement.
I really respect you, Klan.

(Michel didn't have to go out of his way to say
something that'd make Klan-senpai mad...)

...This time, I will NOT let it slide!!
Stay right there, Michel!!
rows.notes: Soko ni naore = stay there (and take your punishment), as slice 334.

rows.en:
(Ahh... Please don't go on a rampage inside
the shop like that, Klan-senpai...)
Kyaaaaaaaah! So cuuute!!
(Hm? What now?)

Pino-Pino in a china dress is sooo cute!
Can I just take her home with me like this?
rows.notes: Pinopino: Yui's nickname for Pinon, kept as 'Pino-Pino'. Mochikaeru also means restaurant takeout.

rows.en: L-let me go, Yui!

Seriously, I just wanna keep her
as my hug pillow~
Le~t~~ me~ gooo~~~~!

Hoshimura, Pinon-chan clearly hates this.
Come on, let her go already.

Tch...
You're such a meanie, \p!
Th-that was close...

P-Pinon-chan...
W-would you like to come over
to my place today...?

Eek! N-no way!!
The way Claire's looking at me is
scarier than ever...

Let's do something fun together...
Pinon-chan......
Nooo~~~ waaaaaaaaaay~~~!!
Things are getting kind of rowdy around here.

Why not? It's a festival, after all.
We'd be missing out if we didn't have
as much fun as we can.

Come on, we've still got plenty of customers
coming, so let's keep at it!
Yeah, let's give it our all!

(Phew, I'm beat...
I never expected that many customers.)

Good work today,
\p-kun.

You too, Nanase.
You were really efficient. I guess that's
what working at the real Nyan-Nyan does.

Yes, Nanase-san was absolutely amazing!
She looked the best in a china dress, by far!

(Luca... Nobody was even talking
about the china dresses...)

Finally, it's over.
I've had it with exhausting stuff like this.

For someone saying that, you sure
looked like you were having fun.
Hmph! You're imagining things...
(Alto's so contrary.)
(And so the fun Culture Fest is over...)

Wait, what are we doing about
the remodeled classroom?

No worries there! For me, a job like this
is easy-peasy. It'll be back to normal
in no time!

(I'm dying to know how she remodeled it...
but I bet I'm better off not asking...)

(Ahh, the Culture Fest was really fun...
Next year, I hope it'll be just as fun...)
rows.notes: Trails into the next row as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (No, I hope it's even more fun than this year!)
(Today's the Culture Fest I've been waiting for!)

Wait... This was just a regular classroom
until yesterday, right...?

\p-san, Yui,
we don't have time for idle chatter.
Hurry up and get ready to open.

Wait, you even got Nyan-Nyan
china dresses ready, huh...
(Hee hee, that's Miyuki for you.)
rows.notes: The female player calls Shirakawa by her given name.

rows.en:
(Saotome-kun in a china dress, huh...
Part of me kind of wants to see that...)

(Whoops, this is no time for daydreaming.
I need to hurry and get ready to open.)

(Thanks partly to the china dresses,
business is booming. But that means we're
so busy we're short on hands...)
Hee hee, how do I look, \p-chan?
We're counting on you, Claire-senpai.

...Yuu, I think you should say that
kind of thing while Claire-senpai is
actually here.
rows.notes: The female player calls Akimizu by her given name.

rows.en:
(Yuu really does adore
Claire-senpai, doesn't she.)

(Huh? Come to think of it,
where did Klan-senpai go?)

(I see...
She went to show Michel-kun her china dress.)

(Michel-kun didn't have to go out of his way
to say something that'd make Klan-senpai mad...)
(Hm? What is it now?)

Yui, Pinon-chan clearly hates this.
That's enough. Let her go.

Let's do something fun together...
Pinon-chan...
Things are getting kind of rowdy around here.
You're right. Let's do our best!

(Phew, I'm beat...
I never expected that many customers.)

Good work today,
\p-san.

You too, Nanase.
You were really efficient. I guess that's
what working at the real Nyan-Nyan does.

(Luca-kun... Nobody was even talking
about the china dresses...)
(Saotome-kun's so contrary.)

Wait, what are we doing about
the remodeled classroom?

(I'm dying to know how she remodeled it...
but I bet I'm better off not asking...)

(Ahh, the Culture Fest was really fun...
Next year, I hope it'll be just as fun...)
(No, I hope it's even more fun than this year!)
